short_description: Capture property interest, confirm availability, assign an agent, and manage viewings and follow-up.

questions.question: Where do property enquiries arrive?
options: Property portal (Rightmove, Zillow, PropertyPro, etc.)
Website enquiry form
Phone call
WhatsApp / messaging
Referral
Walk-in
Not sure

questions.question: What details do you collect before assigning an agent?
options: Specific property of interest
Budget range
Preferred location
Move-in or purchase timing
Buyer or tenant readiness / status
None — assigned immediately with just contact details
Not sure

questions.question: How do you check whether the property is still available and who confirms that information?
options: Live status in our CRM / property listing software checked by coordinator
Shared spreadsheet checked manually
Asking the listing agent or landlord via WhatsApp / phone
Assumed available unless someone remembers otherwise
Not sure

questions.question: How is the enquiry assigned, and how does the agent know a response is due?
options: Assigned automatically in CRM with SLA alert
Manually forwarded by admin / reception via email or WhatsApp
Posted to a shared group chat — whoever responds first takes it

questions.question: How are viewing slots agreed, confirmed and changed?

Back-and-forth phone calls or WhatsApp between prospect, agent, and current occupant
Coordinator checks agent calendar and emails confirmation
Not sure

options: Showing agent logs notes in CRM and sets follow-up task
Agent sends a quick message or tells coordinator verbally
No formal log — agent follows up if the prospect seems keen
Not sure

questions.placeholder: e.g. Prospect is offered similar listings manually, or no-shows aren't logged systematically...
